claims.text: Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".
Released PDF is 44 pages, marked UNCLASSIFIED//FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY (FOUO caveat partially illegible in the scan).

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.

Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Antigravity for Aerospace Applications", series "Acquisition Threat Support", published 2010-03-30 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2009-12-01, DIA document number DIA-08-1003-018. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

a.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)

edges.label: deliverable under AAWSAP
edges.note: The released document names the programme itself. Its inside cover reads 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency ... Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program' - the redaction between them is (b)(3):10 USC 424. Verified by downloading this DIRD and scanning its full text on 23 August 2026. The scans are OCR-degraded, so the quotation is normalised from the damaged rendering.

b.label: EarthTech International / Institute for Advanced Studies at Austin

edges.label: authored at EarthTech International
edges.note: EarthTech International supplied six of the 38 DIRDs through Eric Davis plus one through Hal Puthoff, making it the single most represented institution on the author list.

edges.label: published and holds; DIA-08-1003-018
edges.note: DIA commissioned, holds and released this document. It carries a DIA document number in the DIA-08-xxxx-xxx series on its cover and was released through the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room, whose FileId entry is cited here alongside the retrievable copy. Cover page read on 22 August 2026.

edges.label: authored
edges.note: DIA list item 11 names "Dr Eric Davis, EarthTech International". Independently confirmed by EarthTech International's own publication list, which cites the document as Davis, E. W. (2010) with document number DIA-08-1003-018 and originating office Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3), Defense Warning Office.

edges.label: series member
edges.note: Membership of the DIRD series is established by the released document itself: its cover page carries the Defense Intelligence Reference Document mark and the DIA Defense Futures banner. Document number DIA-08-1003-018. Publication date 30 March 2010 on the cover. 45 pages in the released copy. The cover of the scanned release is degraded, so a document number or date is asserted here only where it reads unambiguously.
